name: studium-vscode
description: Run a Studium adaptive lesson in VS Code: a tutoring loop driven over the lesson-mcp server, with an artifact pane that renders each scene's figures, equations, interactive plots, and executed reference runs — pair by pair.

commands.title: Studium: Contributions de la classe / Community contributions

capsule.description: The capsule_ref the reproduction scene runs (provisioned + executed in the user's workspace; Studium never executes).

studium.repoRoot.description: Absolute path to the prototype-build monorepo (defaults to the extension's own monorepo root).

studium.bundlesRoot.description: Directory the lesson-mcp server resolves bundle_ref against (BUNDLES_ROOT). Leave empty to use the repo's own fixtures/ folder.

studium.bundleRef.description: The bundle to open (relative to bundlesRoot). Defaults to the L1 atomistique demo.

studium.communityBundlesRoot.description: Root the 'Contributions de la classe / Community contributions' command discovers approved learner-authored bundles against (the course bundles root the scene-synth decide_item path emits <courseRoot>/community/*.zip into). Leave empty to reuse studium.bundlesRoot. The canonical course is never mutated; community items are additive.

studium.assets.description: Where the webview loads KaTeX/Vega from: 'vendor' (offline, bundled in media/vendor — air-gap safe) or 'cdn' (jsdelivr).

studium.telemetryConsent.description: Opt in to consented, pseudonymized class telemetry (STUDIUM_TELEMETRY_CONSENT).

studium.showGraph.description: Open a companion live Learning-Workflow-Graph panel that repaints each turn (typed-graph-lens).

studium.graphView.description: Graph scope: 'student' (ego-graph around the current frontier) or 'teacher' (the whole graph).

studium.showMastery.description: Show the live per-concept mastery bar in the lesson pane. OFF by default: it is a teacher/model signal, and showing it to a learner during a quiz can leak the answer (try options, watch which raises mastery). Turn on only for teacher demos.

enumDescriptions: Lead with the visual modality: 3D orbital / molecule / plot / spectrum renders are ordered first and expanded; equations & text are collapsed (kept, openable).
Lead with the textual modality: equations, markdown & concise summaries are ordered first and expanded; figures & 3D are collapsed (kept, openable).
Balanced — the authored order, no extra emphasis (default).
studium.modalityPreference.description: Modality-adaptive rendering (Ciussi, "comment mieux apprendre si je suis visuel"). Reorders and emphasizes each scene's artifacts toward the learner's preferred modality. Content-preserving: nothing is removed — the non-preferred modality is collapsed, never hidden.

scripts.test: pnpm typecheck && for d in scene-io asset-path webview-pane community modality review-fsrs run-task lesson-walk; do echo "--- $d ---" && tsx "src/$d.driver.ts" || exit 1; done
scripts.vendor: mkdir -p media/vendor/katex && cp node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.js node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.css media/vendor/katex/ && cp -R node_modules/katex/dist/fonts media/vendor/katex/fonts && cp node_modules/vega/build/vega.min.js node_modules/vega-lite/build/vega-lite.min.js node_modules/vega-embed/build/vega-embed.min.js media/vendor/ && cp node_modules/cytoscape/dist/cytoscape.min.js node_modules/dagre/dist/dagre.min.js node_modules/cytoscape-dagre/dist/cytoscape-dagre.js node_modules/3dmol/build/3Dmol-min.js media/vendor/
